problems.sentence: The authors note that the cross-sectional design prevents confirmation of causal sequences, that self-reported positive mental health may not capture culturally distinct well-being, that PARS-3 reliability was modest (α = 0.634), that convenience sampling limits generalizability, and that the variance explained was low (R2 = 0.014).
problems.paper_says: the variance in positive mental health explained by physical activity and the covariates in our model was low ( R 2 = 0.014)
